Ultraman R/B (pronounced "Ruebe") is the 30th entry in the Ultraman Series, which aired from July 7 to December 22, 2018. Here's what I know about it:

## Basic Premise
The series follows two brothers, Katsumi and Isami Minato, who transform into Ultraman Rosso and Ultraman Blu respectively. They live in Ayaka City and must protect it from kaiju attacks while dealing with their everyday lives.

## Main Characters
- **Katsumi Minato** - The older brother who becomes Ultraman Rosso (red-colored)
- **Isami Minato** - The younger brother who becomes Ultraman Blu (blue-colored)
- **Asahi Minato** - Their younger sister who later becomes Ultrawoman Grigio
- **Ushio Minato** - Their father
- **Makoto Aizen** - The main antagonist who becomes Ultraman Orb Dark

## Transformation & Powers
- The brothers use **R/B Gyros** and **R/B Crystals** to transform
- They can change attributes/elements by using different crystals (Fire, Water, Wind, Earth)
- Later in the series, they can fuse into **Ultraman Ruebe**
- Each form has different abilities based on the crystal combinations used

## Key Themes
- Family bonds and brotherhood
- Balancing superhero duties with everyday life
- Comedy mixed with action (lighter tone compared to some Ultraman series)

## Notable Features
- First Ultraman series to feature two brothers as dual protagonists
- Introduced the concept of element-based form changes
- Part of the New Generation Heroes lineup
- Has connections to previous Ultraman series through various crystal powers

The series was followed by a movie, "Ultraman R/B The Movie: Select! The Crystal of Bond" in 2019.
